title: Smoky Cannellini Bean Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole perfect for a chilly evening, featuring smoky flavors and creamy cannellini beans.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the smoky paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cannellini beans, sauerkraut, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Roll out the pastry sheet to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the bean mixture to one half of the pastry sheet, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry sheet over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the casserole on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
